protocol.detector_note: yolov3-darknet: conf is also its NMS score threshold (the Darknet baseline's own convention); Ultralytics models: imgsz 640, person class only
protocol.coordinates: MOT 1-based top-left pixels; detector x1,y1 shifted by +1 when cached
protocol.clipping: GT, ignore regions and detections are clipped to the frame: MOT17 annotates bodies that leave the image, Ultralytics clips its outputs, and the Darknet port clips after NMS, so every detector is scored under one box convention
protocol.ignore_handling: pycocotools iscrowd regions: a detection whose intersection over its own area with an ignore box reaches the IoU threshold is neither TP nor FP; other classes are dropped
protocol.ap: pycocotools COCO AP@[.5:.95] and AP50, area range all, maxDets 1000, only frames that were run

operating_point.matching: pycocotools greedy by score at IoU 0.5 (same matching as AP); detections below conf 0.3 dropped afterwards, which equals matching only kept detections
